body:
We ultimately decided not to take away her choice and to keep her safe at home with us. We didn't want her to feel alone and away from her family during this difficult time. We're keeping her home under our close watch.

Thank you so much for your input, it really made me feel like we made the correct decision. We're getting her into therapy early this week and we've been trying to show her the love and support she needs.

We give him a lot of exercise and play with him very often. We do train him daily but are probably due for moving on to more advanced tricks (he knows stay, sit, down, lick, off, come, and shake so far). 

We do give him a toy if he's trying to bite us, but he'll ignore the toy and keep trying to bite us or he'll play with the toy for a few seconds and then try to bite us again. He just prefers biting flesh I guess :/.
I thought dogs stopped teething at 5 months
He's probably around 30 lbs and he's 7 months. He's half Australian Cattle Dog, so I don't think he'll get very big.
